title: Realty stocks jump; DLF nears 52-week high

timeline.title: Realty stocks jump; DLF nears 52-week high
timeline.line: Oberoi, Sobha and Lodha rose about 5%; Prestige, Phoenix Mills, Godrej Properties 4%
more: Nifty Realty was the top sector at 12:02, up 3.4%
Jefferies said Q2 pre-sales beat its estimates for DLF, Oberoi, Godrej Properties and Prestige
The realty index is up 14% so far in November
